fr-jacobsville-sandstone-quarries-easter.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (Town 53 North page) marks "Quarries" and the Portage River light house on the Keweenaw Bay shore here, so the quarry ground was still worked or marked in 1911.

m-gath-lake-linden.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (Town 55 North page) shows the stamp mill on the Torch Lake shore at Lake Linden.
